name: CoCo-Pi hosted NitrOS-9 EOU update (2026-11-13)
changes: Replace Linux MAME/XRoar EOU choices with local 6309/2MB boot, optional isolated DriveWire disks/time, manual GShell and outgoing SuperComm.
Prepare new owner-media copies; preserve originals, ROMs and existing multi-USB pyDriveWire configuration. No emulator replacement, reboot, reflash or new SD image.
Optional incoming Telnet capability is manual; repeated disconnect/reconnect remains unsupported. Native Windows11 refresh is separately deferred.

fixes.description: Install verified TNFS v26.1015.1 if missing or incomplete; no reboot needed.
Disable automatic USB printer setup; retain CUPS and manual printing. No reboot needed.
Build/install MC6801 tools v1.2.0 and PL/M-09 0.4.2 with regression checks; preserve existing sim6809.
Prepare verified, already-downloaded MCX128 firmware for XRoar; preserve MAME ZIPs and custom raw ROMs. No reboot needed.
Add verified YA-DOS 0.5D for CHDX; update the shipped ROM download setting and preserve existing ROMs. No reboot needed.
Build/install bcc09 0.11.0 for terminal use; use bcc09-prefixed companion tools and preserve existing as09 and sim6809.
Refresh hosted NitrOS-9 EOU profiles and prepare new media when owner downloads are present; preserve originals and serial-server configuration. No reboot/reflash or emulator replacement.
